In the press · Guest post · 12 October 2026

One Dollar Below $2 Million: How a Tax Line Moved NYC's Recorded Prices

Published in Housing Notes, Jonathan Miller's newsletter on the New York housing market and the appraisal industry, which has more than 11,000 subscribers. Miller co-founded the appraisal and consulting firm Miller Samuel in 1986 and for 32 years wrote the Elliman Report, Douglas Elliman's market reports. The post is a short version of the $2 million tax-line story, based on The Shape of the Tax.

Read the guest post →
